fixedAt: 2026-09-24 (written after frame extraction, BEFORE any SfM model or registration result of this lane existed)
units: station UVY source-model units (March registration), never surveyed metres; pixels at 1920x1080

designA.fit: Sim3 (then optional March-anchored BA) from PnP-verified cross-epoch 3D-3D pairs between this lane's model and the registered March model (1f-2026-sfm/sparse/2) at BOTH centre passes (pass 1 = K01/K02, pass 2 = K08-K12). March points within 0.3 u of any evaluated class-a surface/portal are excluded from the fit.
heldOut: MainShell facade near GATE1 (U- end, far-end control)

designB.when: only if design A fails ONLY at far-end MainShell controls because of along-walk scale drift
designB.fit: design A anchors + MainShell GATE1 facade (point-to-plane) in an anchored BA
designB.heldOut: MainShell surfaces not used in the fit (U- end surfaces perpendicular to the GATE1 facade, U+ end facade), centre class-a planes, plumb, floor normals, continuity; the rear-row interior (#9-#16) then has NO independent metric check and components there cannot exceed class b unless a held-out surface covers them

interPassDrift.what: pass-1-only vs pass-2-only Sim3 applied to the same model

classAPlanes.what: lane points (>=3 views, err<=2 px, tri>=2 deg) inside each March class-a plane box (+0.3 u)

mainShellControl.what: lane points (>=3 views, err<=2 px, tri>=2 deg) within 1.0 u of MainShell facade triangles in the control zone

plumb.what: vertical vanishing direction (LSD) vs registered camera up, frames with >=10 supporting segments

floorNormal.what: robust plane over lane floor points per section (centre / rear row / U- end / U+ end)
floorNormal.floorYDiagnostic: Ground_Floor Y0 is a generated fill; median floor Y reported, not gated

travelContinuity.scope: consecutive frames within a clip at 3 fps

crossVideo.note: both sibling registrations were rejected; comparison is informational
